title: Monthly Review

launchpad.outcome: Zoom out across strategy, behavior and risk patterns, and turn a rule-change idea into a research study.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Is this change supported by evidence?

slides.title: Monthly review
lines: Patterns by environment, quality, direction. Then: if you want to change a rule, propose a change.

takeaways: A rule change starts as a hypothesis.
